title: Critères de West Haven
formula:
The West Haven Criteria are based on the following clinical findings:

| Variable | Grade |
| --- | --- |
| Abnormal psychometric/neuropsychological tests without clinical manifestations | 0 |
| Impaired attention/computation/sleep; euphoria/anxiety; oriented to time/space | 1 |
| Disoriented to time/space; inappropriate behavior; personality changes; dyspraxia; asterixis; apathy | 2 |
| Somnolence/semistupor; gross disorientation; confusion; bizarre behavior; responsive to stimuli | 3 |
| Coma | 4 |

how_to_use.why: The West Haven Criteria allow clinicians to classify severity of encephalopathy, communicate clearly about a patient's level of consciousness, and trend changes in their mental status.
how_to_use.when:
- Patients avec cirrhose connue et antécédent d’encéphalopathie hépatique.
- Patients avec ou sans cirrhose connue, mais chez qui l’on suspecte une maladie hépatique et qui présentent une altération de l’état mental.

next_steps.advice:
- Use this tool to support, not replace, clinical judgment, and interpret hepatic encephalopathy grade in the context of baseline cognition and the overall clinical scenario.
- Grades 2–4 are generally considered overt hepatic encephalopathy.
- Lactulose, with or without rifaximin, may be used to treat acute hepatic encephalopathy or prevent recurrence.
- Always consider other causes of altered mental status in these patients, as they are at high risk for comorbidities and complications, including bleeding, infection, drug interactions, and electrolyte disturbances.
- For patients with significantly decreased level of consciousness, consider also calculating the [Glasgow Coma Score](nabda:calc.glasgow-coma-scale-score-gcs) .
- Reassess grade periodically when mental status changes or after treatment.
- Routine ammonia testing is not necessary to guide treatment.
- For more detailed guidance, refer to local clinical protocols and current guidelines, such as the[2026 American College of Gastroenterology hepatic encephalopathy guideline](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41773757/).
next_steps.critical_actions: Intensifier les soins en urgence en cas de coma, d’incapacité à protéger les voies aériennes, de convulsions, d’agitation sévère, de choc, de suspicion d’hémorragie digestive ou de suspicion de pathologie intracrânienne.

medium_description: Définit les stades de l'encéphalopathie hépatique.

options.label: Tests psychométriques/neuropsychologiques anormaux sans manifestations cliniques
Impaired attention/computation/sleep; euphoria/anxiété; oriented pour time/space
Disoriented pour time/space; inappropriate behavior; personality changes; dyspraxia; asterixis; apathy
Somnolence/semistupor; gross disorientation; confusion; bizarre behavior; responsive pour stimuli
